BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   C. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money as rumours only.
   B. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   B. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   D. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.

   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
